eyebrow.zh: 长程智能体 · 计划即合约 · 飞行中纠偏

headline.zh:
智能体跑偏了？
第 20 分钟就拦下，不是第 88 分钟
headline.en:
Your agent drifted from the plan.
Catch it at minute 20, not 88.

sub.zh: 把智能体公布的计划变成可对账的合约，实时对照它正在做的事——发现跑偏当场接受、当场写回新版合约。你看到的偏差就是真的偏差，不再有被悄悄丢掉的步骤。
sub.en: Turn the agent's stated plan into a reconcilable contract and watch it against live execution — accept drift on the spot and fold it back into a new versioned contract. What you see is the real drift, with no step silently dropped.

body.zh: 智能体一边跑，你一边看：哪步对上了、哪步跑偏了、哪步没动、哪步多冒出来——都是实时的，贴在你的编码智能体旁边。
body.en: As the agent runs, watch live: which steps matched, which drifted, which never ran, which appeared out of nowhere — in real time, in the pane next to your coding agent.

chips: › 已匹配 / 跑偏 / 未执行 / 多余

title.zh: 你的 trace 不再对你撒谎
title.en: Your trace stops lying to you

body.zh: 以前，摘要里一个换行就会让那一步的事件被悄悄丢掉——步骤明明跑了却显示没动，专门用来抓跑偏的工具自己却在丢证据。现在每一步事件都落得进去、留得下来；即便某行 trace 读不出来，你也会直接看到报错，而不是一本假干净的账本。
body.en: Before, a stray newline in a step summary would silently drop that event — a step that actually ran showed up as never started, so the tool built to catch drift was itself losing evidence. Now every step event lands and stays; if a trace line can't be read, you see the error outright instead of a falsely clean ledger.

title.zh: 接受跑偏，当场写回合约
title.en: Accept drift, patch the contract on the spot

body.zh: 按 a 接受跑偏的步骤，再一条命令把接受的偏差折回新版计划合约——版本递增、留痕可查。计划跟着智能体一起演进，每一次修订都是账本里一条可审计的记录，不再是写不回去的死笔记。
body.en: Press a to accept a drifted step, then one command folds the accepted deviation back into a new versioned plan contract — version bumped, receipt on the record. The plan evolves with the agent, and every revision is an auditable entry in the ledger, not a dead-end note.

body.zh: 对账只看步骤在不在、验收关键词对不对——不请另一个大模型来打分。所以一个周末能搭起来，而且全程可审计、可复现。
body.en: Matching is just step-presence and keyword acceptance-criteria — no second model scoring it. So it builds in a weekend and stays fully auditable and reproducible.

headline.en: Turn drift into a flight record

sub.zh: 一条命令装上，给长程智能体配上可对账、可修订的计划合约。
sub.en: Install in one command — give your long-horizon agent a reconcilable, patchable plan contract.

tag.zh: 长程智能体的飞行记录仪
tag.en: The flight recorder for long-horizon agents
